title: The Root Cellar
text: A trapdoor among the roots of a great tree opens on a cellar stocked with someone's winter stores: apples, smoked meat, jars of honey. It is very well kept. The stair goes deeper than it should, into the dark under the roots.

options.label: Take what you need; whoever keeps the stores is not here.

outcomes.text: You eat well and pass a quiet night above the dark stair.
Its owner comes home, up the stair from under the roots.

options.label: Leave coin for what you take, hoping its owner is honest too.

outcomes.text: The food is honestly bought and the night is quiet. The dark below stays dark.

options.label: The sharpest searches deeper to see where the stair leads.

outcomes.text: Behind a false wall are old coins. The stair keeps going down.
